item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight: SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Thanks for the crit.

I thought about it for a few days and I think I overhauled the idea in a good way. The ship is now capable of (time)travel via another dimension and the entity maybe doesn't want to kill the humans. Also they are not directly melted anymore but sort of dissolved into atoms / molecules.

Yeah, for me the travel and melting into walls was not new either. I hope the new version was not done in media recently. I swear, everything you think of nowadays has been there some way or another.

item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight: SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi Galcedion. Let’s take a look at your concept.

So I like the fact you’re attempting to write a sci-fi scip, doubly so that it involves horror. My main problem with the concept is that it’s the basic plot of almost every Hollywood alien movie out there, mainly: crew goes on a mission, encounters alien they don’t understand, get murdered one-by-one etc. At this point, the genre is tried, tested, and cliqued, to be honest.

I know you’ve tried to give the alien more distinguishing characteristics, but still, the other dimension aspect is from Event Horizon, the melting of the crew into the walls is a page lifted from Aliens. What I’m saying is that the best way to distinguish a sci-fi scip from others is know what’s already out there and have a different origin story of your entity, if you’re sticking with the horror. Right now, you’ve said it’s “unknown”, and that just won’t cut it either. Encourage you to expand on this a little more.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. For now, all the best!

item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight: SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Thanks for your feedback.

1: There are a number ob SCP entries where the Foundation has advanced technology, sometimes even FTL capable vessels. So I think having a ship capable of travelling the solar system is normal for the Foundation.

2: I have not said it in the idea but I would set the SCP in a rather close orbit around the sun, thus it is very unlikely that anyone besides the Foundation / Foundation assets in gov space programs would find the SCP.

3: Well, the behavour of 106 is different, since it's main thing is to corrode things and pull people into another dimension. This SCP would leave structures intact, only attack within atmosphere and pulls people (partially) inside the walls but otherwise leaving them in our world. I will adjust the OP a bit to make that more clear.

item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight: SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
It seems like the kind of horror you would find in the SCP foundation, however there are a few things i think are wrong with it:

1: Does the Foundation have that technology to get spaceships up there? (like actually i dont know if they do)

2: If the Foundation could reach it, that would mean it is close enough to earth for a ship to reach relatively easily, so NASA would have probably noticed it and gotten the word out to the public.

3: Kinda seems like a Space-SCP-106 if you ask me. Pulling people into walls and killing them.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight: SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): vehicle / extradimensional / ad-astra

Elevator Pitch: A dead space ship from the future, which has an invisible entity on board that kills everyone once it is in atmospheric environment.

Central Narrative: The SCP is divided into 2 parts, the ship and the entity. The ship is an advanced human design (not Foundation) that at the current time should not exist. The crew has been killed by the entity and the ship has been vented. One of the Foundation researchers notes a couple of things about the ship including a device that appears to allow travelling through spacetime using another dimension.

The entity can be heard walking around the ship and is pretty harmless in void. It can jump between ships and when in any atmosphere, arms come from the walls, pulling people "inside" the walls and killing them in the process (they are basically split into their atoms rather than melting into the walls). The entity may be from the dimension used by the ship (also the entity might be trying to pull the people into its "dimension").

The team sent to explore the ship finds disfigured humans basically melted to the ships structure. After a while the team is killed by the entity except for 2 members who still die after a while because they run out of oxygen and there is no help coming. Also there will be hints that the entity may even be one of the original crew.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The entity on board the ship is only dangerous under atmospheric pressure but humans need that to survive. It might not be hostile on purpose.

Additional Notes: Hope it's not too generic horror.
